title: Radial Rib Beach Parasol
description: One original static low-poly opened beach parasol with one connected closed thick eight-panel domed canopy, eight continuous curved radial ribs beneath it and eight diagonal fixed stretchers. A genuinely bored upper hub and fixed runner join the ribs and stretchers to one central pole. A bored lower socket and one finite bevelled ballast-style base complete the supported prop. The cream and aqua sectors are material assignments within the same physical thick shell, not separate assets. Twenty-two named editable closed meshes. Five constant opaque PBR materials; no image or procedural textures, logos, people, beach surface or scene. Metres, native Z up, front -Y. Origin is at ground level on the pole axis. One fixed open visual only: geometric support and clear-volume tests do not establish folding or opening motion, kinematics, ultraviolet or sun protection, rain protection, wind resistance, heat comfort, human fit, load capacity, tip resistance, installation or public-space safety performance.
